qs.q: A student records clinical pathology practical observations on loose-leaf sheets instead of the required document. Why is this action penalized under departmental policy?
o: It prevents systematic auditing of weekly laboratory skill acquisition.
It breaches standard protocols for handling departmental hazardous waste.
It violates institutional guidelines for data collection security standards.
It increases the risk of transcription errors during practical grading.
It compromises the required permanent student practical record format.
qs.e: The official logbook is the required permanent medium for tracking all individual practical laboratory exercises.
qs.s: Weekly Year 3: Reference Exam - November 13, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: An examiner checks the logbooks of students in the chemical pathology practical rotation. What consequence follows failure to maintain this required record?
o: Require attendance at mandatory remedial sessions
Bar the student from practical exam entry
Apply a deduction to continuous assessment marks
Suspend the student from clinical ward duties
Issue a formal written warning to the student
qs.e: Failing to maintain the required logbook prevents students from sitting practical examinations.
qs.s: Weekly Year 3: Reference Exam - November 6, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)
